mentions.name: GTA IV multiplayer client
mentions.description: A FiveM/RageMP-style multiplayer client for Grand Theft Auto IV, built to bring online multiplayer play to a game whose official online scene never took off.
mentions.problem: Grand Theft Auto IV's online multiplayer scene never took off.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm a really big fan of Grand Theft Auto IV but its online scene never took off. I'm trying to build a multiplayer client a la FiveM/RageMP for it.
mentions.author: carlos-menezes
